description.p: Cullimingo gets you from a full memory card to a short list of keepers as fast as possible: ingest, cull, filter, export and hand off to your RAW developer.

ul.li: Instant grid and zoomable full-screen loupe for RAW, JPEG and HEIC/HIF files
Ratings, colour labels and pick/reject that round-trip with Capture One and Lightroom through XMP sidecars
2-up and n-up compare, find similar shots, exposure brackets collapsed to one cell
Verified card ingest with rename templates and a read-back backup to a second drive
Full IPTC Core editor with templates, code tables and offline reverse geocoding
Background export and delivery to folders or FTP, FTPS and SFTP servers
RAW+JPEG pairs can be culled as one photo

description.p: Cullimingo works on your files where they are; it is not a catalog and not a RAW developer.
First Flatpak release. The AppImage can now update itself in place with AppImageUpdate or Gear Lever.

Cull RAW+JPEG pairs as one photo: an opt-in setting applies ratings, flags, colours and rotation to both files of a pair, and auto-advance steps past the twin. Renaming always keeps a pair together. New Unflagged and Unrated filter chips.
